title: Parameterized Stripe Attention for Efficient Video Generation
title_zh: DiT 视频生成中的参数化条纹注意力

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) enable high-quality video generation but suffer from substantial inference latency, primarily attributable to the computationally expensive full spatio-temporal attention. While sparse attention methods offer potential solutions, existing approaches face an inherent flexibility–efficiency dilemma: predefined masks lack the flexibility to capture diverse attention patterns, while runtime-determined masks introduce overheads and sacrifice hardware efficiency. We identify the lack of a unified structural characterization of DiT attention as a key limitation of existing methods, and establish that video DiT attention exhibits periodic diagonal stripe structures along both temporal and spatial dimensions. To formally encode these structured patterns within a single efficient kernel, we present PSA , a parameterized stripe attention that formalizes the observed stripe regularity, unifying diverse attention patterns for efficient mask generation. This unified representation enables a single hardware-efficient CUDA kernel to process all sparse patterns, achieving FlashAttention-3-level Model FLOPs Utilization. To determine optimal sparsity configurations, we propose a training-free offline search algorithm that automatically maximizes sparsity under a specified error tolerance for each attention head. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1 demonstrate that PSA achieves 1.57 × \times and 1.37 × \times end-to-end speedups over FlashAttention-3 baselines, with acceptable visual quality degradation.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) [ 18 ] have rapidly emerged as a foundational architecture for image and video generation. DiTs employ Transformers [ 24 ] as the backbone and leverage algorithms such as Diffusion [ 20 , 14 , 15 , 18 ] or Flow Matching [ 11 , 5 ] to iteratively generate images and videos from noise. Prominent open-source models such as Wan 2.1 [ 25 ] and HunyuanVideo [ 8 ] leverage the DiT architecture for tasks like text-to-video and image-to-video synthesis, producing high-quality, highly dynamic video content. However, DiT inference requires multi-step denoising with enormous computational costs and prolonged latency. For instance, generating a 5-second, 720p video with Wan 2.1 on an NVIDIA H100 GPU takes nearly 30 minutes [ 25 ] , severely limiting practical applications. Since these models utilize full spatio-temporal 3D attention [ 32 ] , the attention computation constitutes the primary bottleneck, accounting for over 60% [ 8 ] of the total inference time. Consequently, designing more efficient attention mechanisms is a critical optimization target. Sparse attention—selectively computing only the most informative token interactions—offers a promising avenue, provided the attention distribution exhibits exploitable structure.

paragraphs.en: Existing sparse attention methods for DiTs lack a principled structural characterization of attention distributions, leading to an inherent trade-off between flexibility and efficiency. The first category relies on predefined masks designed from empirical observations rather than principled analysis. SVG [ 28 ] identifies only two fixed patterns—temporal and spatial heads—without analyzing why only these two arise or where the observed periodicity originates; consequently, it cannot capture the diverse stride, offset, and hybrid patterns revealed by our analysis. STA [ 35 ] achieves efficient local computation via tile-wise sliding windows, but assumes only local attention and cannot represent long-range, strided, or hybrid structures as shown in fig. 1 . Because these methods are not grounded in a comprehensive characterization of attention patterns, their fixed masks inevitably fail to cover the full diversity of sparse structures. The second category pursues more flexible pattern representations by determining the sparse mask dynamically at runtime , effectively treating attention distributions as arbitrary. For example, SVG2 [ 31 ] clusters Q and K tokens separately to enable flexible sparse patterns, overlooking the structural regularity revealed by our analysis. This abandonment of structure comes at a cost: the irregular cluster-based kernel’s reliance on FlashInfer [ 33 ] precludes Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) utilization and introduces non-trivial padding overhead ( ∼ \sim 20% at 70% sparsity) despite token permutation; and the clustering procedure itself incurs additional computational cost ( ∼ \sim 10% at 70% sparsity). Consequently, the flexibility–efficiency trade-off in existing methods stems from the lack of a principled, unified framework to characterize sparse attention: methods with fixed masks fail to cover the full diversity of DiT-specific sparse structures, while methods pursuing flexibility sacrifice efficiency by treating attention distributions as arbitrary rather than structured. This motivates the need for a more mechanistic understanding of DiT attention patterns that can support both broad pattern coverage and high-performance implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的针对 DiT 的稀疏注意力方法缺乏对注意力分布的原则性结构刻画，导致灵活性与效率之间存在内在的权衡。 第一类方法依赖于基于经验观察而非原则性分析设计的预定义掩码。 SVG [ 28 ] 仅识别出两种固定模式——时间头与空间头——却没有分析为什么只出现这两种模式，也没有探究所观察到的周期性的来源；因此，它无法捕捉我们分析所揭示的多样化的步长、偏移和混合模式。 STA [ 35 ] 通过按瓦片滑动的窗口实现了高效的局部计算，但仅假设了局部注意力，无法表示如图 1 所示的长程、跨步或混合结构。 由于这些方法并非建立在对注意力模式的全面刻画之上，其固定掩码不可避免地无法覆盖稀疏结构的全部多样性。 第二类方法通过在运行时动态确定稀疏掩码来追求更灵活的模式表示，实际上将注意力分布视为任意的。 例如，SVG2 [ 31 ] 分别对 Q 和 K token 进行聚类以实现灵活的稀疏模式，却忽视了我们的分析所揭示的结构规律性。 这种对结构的放弃是有代价的：基于不规则聚类的核依赖 FlashInfer [ 33 ]，因而无法利用张量内存加速器（TMA），并且尽管进行了 token 重排，仍引入了不可忽略的填充开销（在 70% 稀疏度下约 20%）；此外，聚类过程本身还会带来额外的计算开销（在 70% 稀疏度下约 10%）。 因此，现有方法中灵活性与效率的权衡源于缺乏一个刻画稀疏注意力的原则性统一框架：采用固定掩码的方法无法覆盖 DiT 特有稀疏结构的全部多样性，而追求灵活性的方法则通过将注意力分布视为任意的而非结构化的，牺牲了效率。 这就需要对 DiT 注意力模式有更机制化的理解，以同时支持广泛的模式覆盖和高性能实现。

paragraphs.en: Concretely, sparse attention for video DiTs involves three main challenges: (1) A principled characterization of the DiT attention structure space is needed, providing a unified and sufficiently expressive description of the diverse sparse patterns that emerge across heads, layers, and denoising timesteps. (2) A hardware-aware implementation must be developed that supports various mask configurations while maximizing GPU utilization. (3) An efficient search method is required to determine per-head sparse configurations without incurring additional inference-time overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，面向视频 DiT 的稀疏注意力涉及三个主要挑战：(1) 需要对 DiT 注意力结构空间进行系统性的刻画，为在不同头、层和去噪时间步上出现的多样稀疏模式提供统一且足够有表现力的描述。 (2) 必须开发一种硬件感知的实现，在支持各种掩码配置的同时最大化 GPU 利用率。 (3) 需要一种高效的搜索方法来确定每个头的稀疏配置，且不产生额外的推理时开销。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose PSA , a parameterized stripe sparse attention framework. First, we reveal that video DiT attention exhibits periodic diagonal stripe structures along both temporal and spatial dimensions, through theoretical derivation (via RoPE-3D logit decomposition and video spatio-temporal redundancy) and large-scale empirical validation across all attention heads in HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1 ( fig. 1 ), identifying four primary patterns: intra-frame, inter-frame, hybrid, and uniform (see section 3.1 for details). Second, based on this structural understanding, we design a parameterized mask ℳ ⁡ ( T w , T o , T s , S w , S o , S s ) \mathcal{M}(T_{w},T_{o},T_{s},S_{w},S_{o},S_{s}) that provides a unified representation of periodic stripe sparse patterns across attention heads, with quantitative evaluation demonstrating high-fidelity approximation of full attention outputs (average cosine similarity of 0.9831). Leveraging this unified representation, we support different patterns with a single kernel, eliminating multi-kernel launch overhead. Our implementation adopts block-wise partitioning as the fundamental granularity to fully exploit modern GPU hardware resources, achieving 61% Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) on HunyuanVideo—close to FlashAttention-3 levels—thereby resolving the flexibility–efficiency tension. Finally, observing strong similarity in attention masks across different prompts, we design an offline parallel search algorithm that requires no training and introduces no runtime search overhead, assigning the mask with the highest sparsity to each head while maintaining error bounds. Our parametric pattern representation and offline search achieve both objectives: head-adapted patterns are determined prior to inference, thereby eliminating runtime overhead while preserving adaptability . We validate our method on HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1, achieving 1.57 × \times and 1.37 × \times end-to-end speedups over FlashAttention-3, respectively, with acceptable quality degradation (PSNR > > 23). In summary, our main contributions are as follows.

sents.zh: 首先，我们通过理论推导（借助 RoPE-3D logit 分解与视频时空冗余性）以及在 HunyuanVideo 和 Wan 2.1 中对所有注意力头的大规模实证验证（图 1），揭示了视频 DiT 注意力在时间与空间维度上均呈现周期性对角条带结构，并识别出四种主要模式：帧内、帧间、混合和均匀（详见 3.1 节）。

sents.en: Second, based on this structural understanding, we design a parameterized mask ℳ ⁡ ( T w , T o , T s , S w , S o , S s ) \mathcal{M}(T_{w},T_{o},T_{s},S_{w},S_{o},S_{s}) that provides a unified representation of periodic stripe sparse patterns across attention heads, with quantitative evaluation demonstrating high-fidelity approximation of full attention outputs (average cosine similarity of 0.9831).
sents.zh: 其次，基于对这种结构的理解，我们设计了一个参数化掩码 ℳ ⁡ ( T w , T o , T s , S w , S o , S s ) \mathcal{M}(T_{w},T_{o},T_{s},S_{w},S_{o},S_{s})，为各注意力头的周期性条带稀疏模式提供了统一表示，定量评估表明其对完整注意力输出具有高保真近似（平均余弦相似度为 0.9831）。

sents.en: Leveraging this unified representation, we support different patterns with a single kernel, eliminating multi-kernel launch overhead.
sents.zh: 利用这一统一表示，我们以单个内核支持不同模式，消除了多内核启动开销。

sents.en: Our implementation adopts block-wise partitioning as the fundamental granularity to fully exploit modern GPU hardware resources, achieving 61% Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) on HunyuanVideo—close to FlashAttention-3 levels—thereby resolving the flexibility–efficiency tension.
sents.zh: 我们的实现采用分块划分作为基本粒度，以充分利用现代 GPU 硬件资源，在 HunyuanVideo 上达到 61% 的模型浮点运算利用率（MFU），接近 FlashAttention-3 的水平，从而化解了灵活性–效率之间的矛盾。

sents.en: Finally, observing strong similarity in attention masks across different prompts, we design an offline parallel search algorithm that requires no training and introduces no runtime search overhead, assigning the mask with the highest sparsity to each head while maintaining error bounds.
sents.zh: 最后，我们观察到不同提示词之间的注意力掩码具有高度相似性，据此设计了一种无需训练且不引入运行时搜索开销的离线并行搜索算法，在保持误差上界的同时为每个注意力头分配稀疏度最高的掩码。

sents.en: Our parametric pattern representation and offline search achieve both objectives: head-adapted patterns are determined prior to inference, thereby eliminating runtime overhead while preserving adaptability .
sents.zh: 我们的参数化模式表示与离线搜索同时实现了两个目标：适用于各注意力头的模式在推理前即已确定，从而在保持适应性的同时消除了运行时开销。

sents.en: We validate our method on HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1, achieving 1.57 × \times and 1.37 × \times end-to-end speedups over FlashAttention-3, respectively, with acceptable quality degradation (PSNR > > 23).
sents.zh: 我们在 HunyuanVideo 和 Wan 2.1 上验证了我们的方法，与 FlashAttention-3 相比分别实现了 1.57 × \times 和 1.37 × \times 的端到端加速，且质量下降在可接受范围内（PSNR > > 23）。

sents.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows.
sents.zh: 总之，我们的主要贡献如下。

We further introduce 3D-padding to support arbitrary video resolutions with minimal overhead ( ≈ \approx 5% for 720p).

paragraphs.en: We develop a training-free offline search algorithm that maximizes sparsity under a constrained error threshold for each attention head, with support for distributed parallel search to accelerate the process.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种无需训练的离线搜索算法，在每个注意力头的受限误差阈值下最大化稀疏度，并支持分布式并行搜索以加速该过程。

paragraphs.en: The PSA achieves substantial acceleration without compromising effectiveness, outperforming state-of-the-art methods such as SVG2 and STA in both accuracy and efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: PSA 在不牺牲有效性的情况下实现了大幅加速，在准确率和效率上均优于 SVG2 和 STA 等最先进的方法。

paragraphs.en: Attention mechanisms are pivotal to the success of Transformers [ 24 ] , yet their quadratic complexity poses a fundamental efficiency bottleneck. Existing efficient attention methods for video generation primarily construct sparse masks by exploiting the distributional characteristics of attention heatmaps, falling into two paradigms. The first paradigm relies on predefined sparse mask formats . SVG [ 28 ] classifies attention heads into spatial and temporal types and employs online profiling to generate sparse masks. VORTA [ 23 ] trains a lightweight router to dynamically select among full attention, sliding window, and coreset attention patterns. Sparse-vDiT [ 3 ] selects from a set of predefined structural patterns, including diagonal, multi-diagonal, and vertical-stripe sparsity. Additionally, other window-based attention methods exploit the locality of attention. NATTEN [ 6 ] implements sliding window attention for vision tasks, localizing self-attention to nearest neighborhoods. STA [ 35 ] employs tile-wise window attention for improved memory access and parallelism. The second paradigm determines sparse masks dynamically during inference based on attention scores. VMoBA [ 27 ] extends Moba [ 16 ] to adapt spatio-temporal attention within DiTs. MOD-DiT [ 12 ] avoids the sampling overhead of runtime mask determination by linearly extrapolating pattern intensities from early denoising steps. RoPeSLR [ 13 ] combines block-sparse attention with a trained low-rank compensator to restore dropped background contributions. SVG2 [ 31 ] improves efficiency through k k -means clustering of Q Q and K K vectors, followed by token permutation and top- k k cluster selection to identify the most relevant attention regions.
paragraphs.zh: 注意力机制是 Transformer [24] 取得成功的关键，但其二次方复杂度构成了根本性的效率瓶颈。 现有的面向视频生成的高效注意力方法主要利用注意力热图的分布特性来构建稀疏掩码，可分为两类范式。 第一类范式依赖于预定义的稀疏掩码格式。 SVG [28] 将注意力头分为空间和时序两种类型，并采用在线分析来生成稀疏掩码。 VORTA [23] 训练一个轻量级路由器，在完整注意力、滑动窗口和核心集注意力模式之间动态选择。 Sparse-vDiT [3] 从一组预定义的结构模式中进行选择，包括对角、多对角和垂直条纹稀疏模式。 此外，其他基于窗口的注意力方法利用了注意力的局部性。 NATTEN [6] 为视觉任务实现了滑动窗口注意力，将自注意力限定在最近邻域内。 STA [35] 采用分块窗口注意力以改善内存访问和并行性。 第二类范式在推理过程中根据注意力分数动态确定稀疏掩码。 VMoBA [27] 将 Moba [16] 扩展到 DiT 内部以适配时空注意力。 MOD-DiT [12] 通过对早期去噪步骤的模式强度进行线性外推，避免了运行时掩码判定的采样开销。 RoPeSLR [13] 将块稀疏注意力与训练得到的低秩补偿器相结合，以恢复被丢弃的背景贡献。 SVG2 [31] 通过对 Q 和 K 向量进行 k-means 聚类来提升效率，随后进行 token 重排和 top-k 簇选择，以识别最相关的注意力区域。

paragraphs.en: However, existing methods suffer from notable limitations: predefined pattern approaches are constrained by a limited pattern set, while dynamic mask generation leads to non-trivial overhead and poor efficiency, yielding limited speedup over optimized dense implementations such as FlashAttention [ 4 , 19 ] . In contrast, PSA uniformly parameterizes diverse sparse patterns with hardware-aware kernels, achieving superior flexibility and efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有方法存在明显的局限性：预定义模式方法受限于有限的模式集合，而动态掩码生成则带来可观的开销和较低的效率，相比 FlashAttention [ 4 , 19 ] 等优化过的稠密实现只能获得有限的加速。 相比之下，PSA 通过硬件感知的核函数对多种稀疏模式进行统一参数化，实现了更优的灵活性与效率。

paragraphs.en: We show that this structure arises from two complementary properties: (1) video spatio-temporal redundancy , which concentrates high attention scores within local neighborhoods, and (2) RoPE-3D cosine periodicity , which causes attention scores to repeat at axis-dependent intervals.

paragraphs.en: Hardware-Aware Design. Our kernel design targets maximum computational efficiency on modern GPUs by ensuring full utilization of every scheduled thread block, eliminating idle compute units [ 35 ] . To this end, we introduce a fundamental computational abstraction called PSABlock , which represents the minimum data granularity necessary to fully saturate the resources of a single streaming multiprocessor (SM). Notably, PSABlock also aligns with the block-wise characteristics observed in the attention heatmaps ( fig. 1 ), enabling the mask to operate naturally at this granularity. Since PSABlock is the minimum computable unit, PSA applies masking at PSABlock granularity rather than individual tokens. For video tokens organized in 3D structure, a PSABlock comprises constituent blocks along temporal, height, and width dimensions: PSABlock = PSABlock t × PSABlock h × PSABlock w \text{{PSABlock}}=\text{{PSABlock}}_{\text{t}}\times\text{{PSABlock}}_{\text{h}}\times\text{{PSABlock}}_{\text{w}} .
paragraphs.zh: 硬件感知设计。 我们的内核设计旨在通过确保每个被调度的线程块都得到充分利用、消除空闲的计算单元，在现代 GPU 上实现最大的计算效率 [ 35 ] 。 为此，我们引入了一种名为 PSABlock 的基本计算抽象，它表示完全占满单个流式多处理器（SM）资源所需的最小数据粒度。 值得注意的是，PSABlock 还与注意力热力图（图 1）中观察到的分块特性相吻合，使掩码能够天然地在这一粒度上运作。 由于 PSABlock 是最小可计算单元，PSA 在 PSABlock 粒度而非单个 token 上应用掩码。 对于以 3D 结构组织的视频 token，一个 PSABlock 由沿时间、高度和宽度维度的组成块构成：PSABlock = PSABlock t × PSABlock h × PSABlock w \text{{PSABlock}}=\text{{PSABlock}}_{\text{t}}\times\text{{PSABlock}}_{\text{h}}\times\text{{PSABlock}}_{\text{w}} 。

paragraphs.en: The key challenge lies in maintaining high computational efficiency across diverse sparse patterns. We address this through two synergistic mechanisms. First, we reorganize the Q , K , V Q,K,V data layout from the standard ( T , H , W ) (T,H,W) format to a PSABlock -centric arrangement: ( T ′ , H ′ , W ′ CLOSE , (T^{\prime},H^{\prime},W^{\prime}, P ​ S ​ A ​ B ​ l ​ o ​ c ​ k t {PSABlock}_{t} , P ​ S ​ A ​ B ​ l ​ o ​ c ​ k h {PSABlock}_{h} , OPEN P ​ S ​ A ​ B ​ l ​ o ​ c ​ k w ) {PSABlock}_{w}) , where ( T ′ , H ′ , W ′ ) (T^{\prime},H^{\prime},W^{\prime}) denotes the grid of PSABlock s. This transformation ensures contiguous memory placement within each PSABlock , enabling coalesced memory accesses—a prerequisite for the efficient kernel design that follows. Second, building on this layout, our kernel achieves FA3-level efficiency while supporting flexible masks as shown in fig. 3 (b). A dedicated producer warpgroup guided by the mask logic ( algorithm 1 ) identifies required K , V K,V PSABlock s and asynchronously prefetches them into on-chip SRAM via TMA-driven ping-pong buffering. Concurrently, consumer warpgroups perform dense attention computations at PSABlock granularity using resident Q Q and prefetched K , V K,V data. This decoupling of data movement and computation enables hardware-optimized dense operations, maximizing GPU utilization even under sparse attention patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 关键挑战在于如何在多样的稀疏模式下保持高计算效率。 我们通过两个协同机制来解决这个问题。 首先，我们将 Q、K、V 数据布局从标准的 (T,H,W) 格式重组为以 PSABlock 为中心的排列：(T′,H′,W′,CLOSE {PSABlock}_{t}，{PSABlock}_{h}，OPEN {PSABlock}_{w})，其中 (T′,H′,W′) 表示 PSABlock 的网格。 这一变换确保了每个 PSABlock 内存的连续存放，从而支持合并内存访问——这是后续高效内核设计的先决条件。 其次，基于这一布局，我们的内核在实现 FA3 级效率的同时，还能支持灵活的掩码，如图 3 (b) 所示。 由掩码逻辑（算法 1）引导的专用生产者 warp 组识别所需的 K、V PSABlock，并通过 TMA 驱动的乒乓缓冲机制将其异步预取到片上 SRAM 中。 与此同时，消费者 warp 组使用驻留的 Q 数据和预取的 K、V 数据，以 PSABlock 为粒度执行稠密注意力计算。 这种数据搬运与计算的解耦使硬件优化的稠密运算成为可能，即使在稀疏注意力模式下也能最大化 GPU 利用率。

paragraphs.en: 3D-Padding for Resolution Flexibility. The block-aligned computation described above requires that the token dimensions ( T , H , W ) (T,H,W) be divisible by the corresponding PSABlock tile sizes ( P ​ S ​ A ​ B ​ l ​ o ​ c ​ k t , P ​ S ​ A ​ B ​ l ​ o ​ c ​ k h , P ​ S ​ A ​ B ​ l ​ o ​ c ​ k w ) ({PSABlock}_{t},\allowbreak{PSABlock}_{h},\allowbreak{PSABlock}_{w}) . To support arbitrary video resolutions, we employ 3D-padding : each dimension is minimally padded to the smallest multiple of its corresponding PSABlock size, i.e., T ′ = ⌈ T / P ​ S ​ A ​ B ​ l ​ o ​ c ​ k t ⌉ ⋅ P ​ S ​ A ​ B ​ l ​ o ​ c ​ k t T^{\prime}=\lceil T/{PSABlock}_{t}\rceil\cdot{PSABlock}_{t} , ensuring alignment without restricting input geometry. This design enables support for arbitrary video resolutions with minimal computational overhead. For instance, at 720p resolution, padding the height dimension (H) from 45 to 48 tokens during the last 80% of generation steps incurs only 5% overhead ( Overhead = p steps × r padding \text{Overhead}=p_{\text{steps}}\times r_{\text{padding}} , where p steps p_{\text{steps}} denotes the proportion of steps requiring padding and r padding r_{\text{padding}} represents the relative padding ratio).

paragraphs.en: A central challenge in applying the PSA representation is assigning an optimal mask configuration ℳ \mathcal{M} to each attention head. We address this with PSA-Search , an automatic search algorithm grounded in a key empirical observation: attention patterns in DiT models vary significantly across timesteps, layers, and heads, yet remain remarkably stable with respect to input prompts [ 3 ] (see fig. 4 and Appendix G ). This prompt-invariance enables an offline search strategy—optimal sparse configurations can be identified once using a representative dataset and subsequently applied to all future inferences, introducing no runtime overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 应用 PSA 表示的一个核心挑战是为每个注意力头分配最优的掩码配置 ℳ \mathcal{M}。 我们通过 PSA-Search 解决这一问题，这是一种基于关键经验观察的自动搜索算法：DiT 模型中的注意力模式在不同时间步、层和头之间差异显著，但相对于输入提示却保持高度稳定 [ 3 ]（见图 4 和附录 G）。 这种提示不变性使离线搜索策略成为可能——只需使用一个代表性数据集一次性确定最优稀疏配置，随后即可应用于所有后续推理，不引入任何运行时开销。

paragraphs.en: The PSA-Search algorithm operates on a per-head basis, as illustrated in fig. 3 (c). For each attention head, the algorithm iterates through a predefined search space of candidate sparse configurations. Given a user-defined L 2 L_{2} loss threshold α \alpha , the search first identifies all candidate masks satisfying this quality constraint (i.e., L 2 ≤ α L_{2}\leq\alpha ), where the L 2 L_{2} loss is computed between the outputs of the sparse attention and the full attention. Among these qualified candidates, PSA-Search selects the mask achieving maximum sparsity. Furthermore, PSA-Search supports a dual-interface: users can either specify an error tolerance α \alpha to maximize sparsity, or specify a target sparsity level and obtain the corresponding mask with minimal error. To enhance search efficiency, we leverage distributed parallelization across multiple GPUs via Ulysses [ 7 ] . Searching over 100 candidate masks completes in 2.5 hours on 8 H100 GPUs, assigning each head its maximum-sparsity mask under the error constraint without the prohibitive costs of training-based methods.
paragraphs.zh: PSA-Search 算法以逐头（per-head）方式运行，如图 3 (c) 所示。 对于每个注意力头，该算法遍历一个预定义的候选稀疏配置搜索空间。 给定用户定义的 L 2 L_{2} 损失阈值 α \alpha ，搜索首先找出所有满足该质量约束（即 L 2 ≤ α L_{2}\leq\alpha ）的候选掩码，其中 L 2 L_{2} 损失是在稀疏注意力输出与全注意力输出之间计算的。 在这些合格的候选掩码中，PSA-Search 选择实现最大稀疏度的掩码。 此外，PSA-Search 支持双重接口：用户既可以指定误差容限 α \alpha 以最大化稀疏度，也可以指定目标稀疏度并获得误差最小的对应掩码。 为了提高搜索效率，我们借助 Ulysses [7] 在多个 GPU 上进行分布式并行化。 在 8 块 H100 GPU 上，对 100 个候选掩码的搜索可在 2.5 小时内完成，在误差约束下为每个注意力头分配其最大稀疏度的掩码，而无需基于训练的方法所需的高昂成本。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. For quantitative evaluation of frame-level fidelity and perceptual quality, we report Mean Squared Error (MSE), Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM), and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) [ 36 ] . In addition to these per-frame metrics, we conduct a more holistic assessment using the VBench benchmark [ 34 ] . Specifically, we report scores for overall consistency ( OC ) and temporal style adherence ( TS ).
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。 为了对帧级保真度和感知质量进行定量评估，我们报告了均方误差（MSE）、峰值信噪比（PSNR）、结构相似性指数度量（SSIM）以及学习感知图像块相似度（LPIPS）[ 36 ]。 除了这些逐帧指标之外，我们还使用 VBench 基准 [ 34 ] 进行了更整体性的评估。 具体而言，我们报告了整体一致性（OC）和时间风格 adherence（TS）的分数。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare against three sparse attention methods: SVG and SVG2 , evaluated across all models to assess generalizability; and STA , evaluated only on HunyuanVideo at 768×1280 resolution due to its tile-based architectural constraints [ 35 ] . These methods represent the two paradigms discussed in section 1 : SVG and STA employ predefined masks with limited flexibility, while SVG2 determines masks dynamically at runtime, sacrificing hardware efficiency for flexibility.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 我们与三种稀疏注意力方法进行比较：SVG 和 SVG2，在所有模型上进行评估以检验泛化能力；以及 STA，由于其基于图块（tile）的架构限制，仅在 768×1280 分辨率下的 HunyuanVideo 上进行评估 [ 35 ]。 这些方法代表了第 1 节中讨论的两种范式：SVG 和 STA 采用灵活性有限的预定义掩码，而 SVG2 在运行时动态确定掩码，以牺牲硬件效率来换取灵活性。

paragraphs.en: Parameters. All methods target approximately 60% sparsity. For PSA , we construct a discrete candidate space for ℳ \mathcal{M} based on attention heatmap analysis, uniformly sampling about 100 configurations per head. The threshold α \alpha is set to 0.03, 0.018, and 0.007 for HunyuanVideo (720 × \times 1280), HunyuanVideo (768 × \times 1280), and Wan 2.1, respectively. Search uses 1–3 prompts (inter-prompt similarity is high) and evaluation uses all VBench prompts. The initial 20% of diffusion timesteps are exempted from sparsification, as early steps are critical for coarse layout and quality [ 28 , 31 , 29 , 1 , 2 , 37 ] .

paragraphs.en: Kernel performance. To isolate the computational efficiency of our core attention mechanism, we conduct detailed micro-benchmarks of PSA-Kernel against the kernels from SVG, SVG2 and STA under the same mask pattern, as shown in table 2 . Implementation differences across methods may cause slight sparsity variations even under the same mask pattern. Notably, compared to the SVG and SVG2 kernels, our kernel achieves significant speedups of approximately 1.59 × \times and 1.63 × \times on HunyuanVideo (768 × \times 1280), respectively. Moreover, it achieves kernel performance competitive with STA while delivering superior E2E speed—the E2E advantage stems from our FA3-based implementation for unsparsified timesteps (the initial 20% of diffusion steps), whereas STA relies on a slower custom full-attention kernel during these steps. This kernel-level efficiency serves as the foundational driver of the end-to-end latency reductions, confirming that our method’s performance gains stem from a highly optimized computational core.

paragraphs.en: For all baselines, sparsity is an outcome rather than an input : STA’s is fixed by its predefined window masks, SVG’s is quantized to the nearest feasible window combination, and SVG2’s emerges from data-dependent runtime clustering, so an exactly matched sparsity budget cannot be enforced on the baseline side. We therefore evaluate two operating points on HunyuanVideo ( 768 × 1280 768\times 1280 ) whose sparsity strictly brackets all baselines: Ours-min below every baseline and Ours-max above every baseline. As shown in table 4 , PSA dominates every baseline in both speed and quality at both endpoints: Ours-min is the fastest despite computing the most (1.51 × \times vs. at most 1.48 × \times ), and Ours-max achieves the best PSNR despite computing the least (26.76 vs. 25.80), confirming that the conclusions of table 1 hold regardless of any residual sparsity mismatch.

paragraphs.en: We present PSA , a parameterized stripe attention framework for efficient video generation. Our central insight is that video DiT attention is not arbitrary but exhibits periodic diagonal stripe structures along both temporal and spatial dimensions. This structural understanding enables a unified parametric formulation ℳ ⁡ ( T w , T o , T s , S w , S o , S s ) \mathcal{M}(T_{w},T_{o},T_{s},S_{w},S_{o},S_{s}) that resolves the flexibility–efficiency tension inherent in prior methods: it covers all observed attention patterns while permitting a single hardware-efficient CUDA kernel achieving up to 61% MFU. A training-free offline search algorithm then assigns each head its maximum-sparsity mask under an error constraint, introducing no runtime overhead. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1 demonstrate end-to-end speedups of 1.57 × \times and 1.37 × \times over FlashAttention-3 with minimal quality degradation.

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 2 outlines the execution flow of PSA-Kernel , which employs a producer-consumer model to maximize hardware utilization. The workload is partitioned between two concurrently operating warpgroups within each GPU thread block. The producer warpgroup interprets the sparse mask configuration ℳ \mathcal{M} to identify required KV blocks and asynchronously loads them from HBM to shared memory. The consumer warpgroups perform block-wise attention computation on available KV blocks, including safe softmax and result accumulation. Double-buffering with kv_ready and compute_done flags coordinates the pipeline, effectively hiding memory latency behind computation.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 2 概述了 PSA-Kernel 的执行流程，该流程采用生产者-消费者模型来最大化硬件利用率。 工作负载被划分到每个 GPU 线程块内两个并发运行的 warpgroup 中。 生产者 warpgroup 解析稀疏掩码配置 ℳ \mathcal{M}，以确定所需的 KV 块，并将其从 HBM 异步加载到共享内存。 消费者 warpgroup 对可用的 KV 块执行分块注意力计算，包括 safe softmax 和结果累加。 通过 kv_ready 和 compute_done 标志实现的双缓冲机制协调该流水线，从而在计算过程中有效隐藏内存延迟。

paragraphs.en: We present the detailed pseudocode of PSA-Search in algorithm 3 . Given a list of candidate masks 𝒞 ℳ \mathcal{C_{M}} and a user-specified loss threshold α \alpha , the algorithm independently searches for the optimal mask configuration for each attention head. For a given head h h , PSA-Search first evaluates all candidate masks by computing the L 2 L_{2} loss between the sparse attention output and the full attention output, and sorts the results in ascending order of loss. Starting from the lowest-loss mask as the initial best candidate, the algorithm then scans through all qualified masks whose loss does not exceed α \alpha and greedily replaces the current best with any mask that achieves higher sparsity. This design ensures that the selected mask maximizes sparsity while remaining within the acceptable quality budget. After processing all heads, the algorithm returns a complete mask strategy map 𝒮 ℳ \mathcal{S_{M}} that assigns the sparsified yet faithful mask to each head. Notably, since PSA-Search records the per-head loss for every candidate mask, adjusting α \alpha only requires re-executing lines 10–21 without repeating the costly L 2 L_{2} loss evaluation, making the threshold tuning process highly efficient.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在算法 3 中给出了 PSA-Search 的详细伪代码。 给定候选掩码列表 𝒞 ℳ \mathcal{C_{M}} 和用户指定的损失阈值 α \alpha，该算法为每个注意力头独立搜索最优掩码配置。 对于给定的头 h h，PSA-Search 首先通过计算稀疏注意力输出与完整注意力输出之间的 L 2 L_{2} 损失来评估所有候选掩码，并将结果按损失升序排序。 该算法以损失最低的掩码作为初始最佳候选，然后遍历所有损失不超过 α \alpha 的合格掩码，并贪婪地将当前最佳替换为任何能实现更高稀疏度的掩码。 这种设计确保所选掩码在可接受的质量预算内最大化稀疏度。 处理完所有头之后，该算法返回一个完整的掩码策略映射 𝒮 ℳ \mathcal{S_{M}}，为每个头分配稀疏化且忠实的掩码。 值得注意的是，由于 PSA-Search 记录了每个候选掩码在每个头上的损失，调整 α \alpha 只需重新执行第 10–21 行，而无需重复代价高昂的 L 2 L_{2} 损失评估，使阈值调节过程非常高效。

sents.zh: 我们在算法 3 中给出了 PSA-Search 的详细伪代码。

sents.en: Given a list of candidate masks 𝒞 ℳ \mathcal{C_{M}} and a user-specified loss threshold α \alpha , the algorithm independently searches for the optimal mask configuration for each attention head.
sents.zh: 给定候选掩码列表 𝒞 ℳ \mathcal{C_{M}} 和用户指定的损失阈值 α \alpha，该算法为每个注意力头独立搜索最优掩码配置。

sents.en: For a given head h h , PSA-Search first evaluates all candidate masks by computing the L 2 L_{2} loss between the sparse attention output and the full attention output, and sorts the results in ascending order of loss.
sents.zh: 对于给定的头 h h，PSA-Search 首先通过计算稀疏注意力输出与完整注意力输出之间的 L 2 L_{2} 损失来评估所有候选掩码，并将结果按损失升序排序。

sents.en: Starting from the lowest-loss mask as the initial best candidate, the algorithm then scans through all qualified masks whose loss does not exceed α \alpha and greedily replaces the current best with any mask that achieves higher sparsity.
sents.zh: 该算法以损失最低的掩码作为初始最佳候选，然后遍历所有损失不超过 α \alpha 的合格掩码，并贪婪地将当前最佳替换为任何能实现更高稀疏度的掩码。

sents.en: This design ensures that the selected mask maximizes sparsity while remaining within the acceptable quality budget.
sents.zh: 这种设计确保所选掩码在可接受的质量预算内最大化稀疏度。

sents.en: After processing all heads, the algorithm returns a complete mask strategy map 𝒮 ℳ \mathcal{S_{M}} that assigns the sparsified yet faithful mask to each head.
sents.zh: 处理完所有头之后，该算法返回一个完整的掩码策略映射 𝒮 ℳ \mathcal{S_{M}}，为每个头分配稀疏化且忠实的掩码。

sents.en: Notably, since PSA-Search records the per-head loss for every candidate mask, adjusting α \alpha only requires re-executing lines 10–21 without repeating the costly L 2 L_{2} loss evaluation, making the threshold tuning process highly efficient.

paragraphs.en: Discussion. paragraphs.en: As illustrated in fig. 8 , we perform loss threshold sensitivity analysis on various α \alpha values for HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1. The experimental results indicate that larger α \alpha values correspond to higher tolerable loss thresholds, which given the design principle of PSA-Search , result in increased sparsity. To maintain sparsity at approximately 60%, we configured α \alpha as 0.03, 0.018, and 0.007 for HunyuanVideo ( 720 × 1280 ) (720\times 1280) , HunyuanVideo ( 768 × 1280 ) (768\times 1280) , and Wan 2.1, respectively. This observation reveals that Wan 2.1 exhibits higher sensitivity to loss, thereby necessitating a smaller α \alpha value to attain equivalent sparsity levels.

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, we obtain α \alpha values at various sparsity levels through our adaptive search algorithm for reference. As shown in table 10 , setting the corresponding alpha value for a given sparsity level ensures optimal acceleration while minimizing the loss. Note that changing α \alpha does not require a time-consuming re-search, as PSA-Search saves the HeadResults for each head; consequently, after each adjustment of α \alpha , only the re-execution of algorithm 3 (lines 10–21) is needed, taking approximately 2 minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们通过自适应搜索算法获得了不同稀疏度下的 α \alpha 值以供参考。 如表 10 所示，为给定稀疏度设置相应的 alpha 值可在最小化损失的同时确保最优加速。 需要注意的是，改变 α \alpha 无需耗时的重新搜索，因为 PSA-Search 为每个注意力头保存了 HeadResults；因此，每次调整 α \alpha 之后，只需重新执行算法 3（第 10–21 行）即可，耗时约 2 分钟。

paragraphs.en: Beyond our initial analysis at 60% sparsity to match STA’s fixed sparsity (58.37%) for a direct comparison, we evaluate 10–70% sparsity ( table 11 ). Our method consistently outperforms SVG2 in speed/quality, and achieves a better speed–quality trade-off than SVG. SVG only achieves marginal speedup at 70% sparsity while suffering severe quality degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 除了在 60% 稀疏度下进行初步分析以匹配 STA 的固定稀疏度（58.37%）从而实现直接对比之外，我们还评估了 10–70% 的稀疏度（表 11）。 我们的方法在速度/质量上始终优于 SVG2，并取得了比 SVG 更好的速度–质量权衡。 SVG 仅在 70% 稀疏度下实现了微小的加速，同时质量出现严重下降。

paragraphs.en: Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：摘要和引言中提出的主要论点是否准确反映了论文的贡献和范围？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The abstract and introduction clearly state three contributions of PSA (parameterized representation, efficient kernel, automatic search), which are consistent with the theoretical and experimental results in Sections 3–4.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：摘要和引言明确阐述了 PSA 的三项贡献（参数化表示、高效核函数、自动搜索），这与第 3–4 节的理论和实验结果一致。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否讨论了作者所开展工作的局限性？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper discusses limitations in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该论文在附录 A 中讨论了局限性。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每项理论结果，论文是否提供了完整的假设集以及完整（且正确）的证明？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The RoPE-3D attention logit decomposition (Eq. 1) and the dominant channel assumption (Eqs. 2–4) are presented with clear assumptions and derivations in Section 3.1.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：RoPE-3D 注意力logit分解（式1）与主导通道假设（式2–4）在第3.1节中以清晰的假设和推导进行了阐述。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否充分披露了复现论文主要实验结果所需的全部信息，以致于会影响论文的主要论断和/或结论（无论是否提供了代码和数据）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper provides complete algorithm pseudocode (Algorithms 1–3), model configurations (Section 4.1), search parameter ranges (Appendix B), and kernel implementation details (Appendix A), sufficient to reproduce the main experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：论文提供了完整的算法伪代码（算法1–3）、模型配置（4.1节）、搜索参数范围（附录B）以及内核实现细节（附录A），足以复现主要实验。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否按照补充材料中的描述，对数据和代码提供开放访问，并附带足以忠实复现主要实验结果的说明？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The code is publicly available at https://github.com/jxyjason/PSA , with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results.
paragraphs.zh: 论证：代码已在 https://github.com/jxyjason/PSA 公开发布，并附有充分的说明，可忠实地复现主要实验结果。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否说明了理解结果所需的全部训练和测试细节（例如：数据划分、超参数、它们是如何选择的、优化器的类型）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Section 4.1 provides detailed descriptions of model configurations, evaluation metrics, baseline methods, search parameters, and experimental settings.
paragraphs.zh: 理由说明：4.1 节详细描述了模型配置、评估指标、基线方法、搜索参数和实验设置。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否恰当地报告了误差棒（error bars）及其正确定义，或提供了有关实验统计显著性的其他适当信息？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The randomness in video generation evaluation primarily stems from initial noise, while our comparison is between deterministic sparse attention and full attention outputs, so error bars are not required.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：视频生成评估中的随机性主要来自初始噪声，而我们的比较是在确定性稀疏注意力与全注意力输出之间进行的，因此无需误差条。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每个实验，论文是否提供了足够的信息来复现实验所需的计算机资源（计算工作器的类型、内存、执行时间）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper states that all experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, and mentions in Section 3.3 that the search completes in 2.5 hours on 8 H100 GPUs.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：论文说明所有实验均在单张 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上进行，并在第 3.3 节中提到搜索在 8 张 H100 GPU 上于 2.5 小时内完成。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中所开展的研究是否在各方面都符合 NeurIPS 伦理准则 https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ？

paragraphs.en: Justification: This research is an efficiency optimization method for video generation and does not involve human subjects, sensitive data, or ethical risks.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该研究是一种视频生成效率优化方法，不涉及人类受试者、敏感数据或伦理风险。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否讨论了所做工作潜在的社会积极影响和社会消极影响两个方面？

paragraphs.en: Justification: This research is a foundational efficiency optimization method that accelerates inference of existing models and is not directly tied to specific application deployments, with no direct path to negative societal impacts.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本研究是一种基础性的效率优化方法，用于加速现有模型的推理，并不与特定的应用部署直接相关，不存在直接产生负面社会影响的途径。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否描述了针对负责任地发布具有较高误用风险的数据或模型（例如预训练语言模型、图像生成器或抓取的数据集）而采取的保障措施？

paragraphs.en: Justification: This paper does not release new pre-trained models or datasets; it only provides an attention efficiency optimization method.
paragraphs.zh: 说明：本文未发布新的预训练模型或数据集，仅提供了一种注意力效率优化方法。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中使用的资产（如代码、数据、模型）的创作者或原所有者是否得到了恰当的署名，是否明确提及并恰当遵守了许可证和使用条款？

paragraphs.en: Justification: All existing assets used in this paper are properly credited, and their licenses and terms of use are explicitly stated and fully respected.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文中使用的所有现有资产均已妥善注明来源，其许可证和使用条款均已明确说明并得到充分遵守。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中引入的新资产是否有完善的文档记录，并且文档是否随资产一同提供？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The code is released at https://github.com/jxyjason/PSA with documentation provided in the repository; no other new assets are involved.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：代码已在 https://github.com/jxyjason/PSA 发布，仓库中提供了相关文档；不涉及其他新资产。

paragraphs.en: Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 众包与人类受试者研究

paragraphs.en: Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于众包实验和涉及人类受试者的研究，论文是否在适用情况下包含提供给参与者的说明的完整文本及截图，以及有关报酬（如有）的详细信息？

paragraphs.en: Justification: This paper does not involve crowdsourcing or research with human subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文不涉及众包或以人类为对象的研究。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?
